# Synthetic integrity fixtures

These records and the one-page PDF are artificial validator test data. They are not part of the AI for Robotics course, contain no course-source verification, and must never enter `data/bank.json` or the study application. Simulated author/reviewer/inspection identities exist only to exercise gates.

`synthetic_bank.json` requires the explicit validator flag `--allow-synthetic`. Normal validation rejects it. Real question authors and reviewers must inspect actual course evidence rather than copying these simulated acceptance records.
